subject: Closing gap between legends and plot

messages.author: fd6b6652674efe5b
messages.subject: Closing gap between legends and plot
parts:
I encountered a problem in ggplot2 when controlling for aspect ratio in a bar plot:
 
Here is the R code:
factor1<-c("A","A","B","B")
factor2<-c(1,2,1,2)
factor3<-c(3,4,5,6)
bsp.df <- data.frame (factor1, factor2, factor3)
bsp.df
dodge <- position_dodge(width=0.9)
p <- ggplot(bsp.df, aes(fill=factor1, y=factor3, x=factor2, width=0.9))
p <- p + scale_fill_brewer(palette="Set1")
p <- p + coord_equal(ratio=0.8)
p <- p + geom_bar(position=dodge, stat="identity")
p
 
Does somebody know how to close the space between the legends and the plot, if I use coord_equal(ratio=0.8)?
Regards,
Rainer
